name: The assistant itself (English)
description: The self layer of the chat's default base: who the assistant is, what it can do and what its memory holds. Static facts here; the statistics of a memory (entities per class, facts per relation, totals, layers) are generated from the memory's own lexicon by tools/assistant/memory-statistics.mjs when the memory is built (data, regenerated with the memory, never hand-written). Imports core-min and core-en.
